title: Rex: A Family of Reversible Exponential (Stochastic) Runge-Kutta Solvers
abstract: Deep generative models based on neural differential equations have become state-of-the-art for many generation tasks. These models rely on ODE/SDE solvers that integrate from a prior distribution to the data distribution; in many applications it is also highly desirable to integrate in the inverse direction. Standard solvers, however, accumulate discretization errors that prohibit exact inversion, an inaccuracy that is unacceptable in precision-critical applications. Existing inversion methods suffer from poor stability and low order of convergence, and are strictly limited to the ODE setting. In this work, we propose Rex, a family of reversible exponential (stochastic) Runge-Kutta solvers obtained by applying Lawson methods to convert any explicit (stochastic) Runge-Kutta scheme into an algebraically reversible one for both diffusion ODEs and SDEs. Beyond a rigorous theoretical analysis -- establishing arbitrary-order convergence and a non-zero region of linear stability -- we empirically demonstrate that Rex achieves near-machine-precision reconstruction and improves Boltzmann sampling with flow models as well as image generation and editing with diffusion models.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2502.08834v5 全文整理；论文 PDF 提供公开代码 URL，且正文标注为 ICML 2026 proceedings paper。
analysis.ideaZh: 用 Lawson transform 将任意 explicit ODE/SDE Runge–Kutta scheme 变成适配 diffusion dynamics 的 Princeps，再套入闭式可逆的 two-state coupling，从而得到同时支持 generation 与 exact inversion 的 solver family。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它直接改变 diffusion image generation/editing 的 inverse interface，并可迁移到 flow matching、reward backpropagation 和需要保持 bijectivity 的生成设计流程；理论统一性与跨 ODE/SDE 覆盖达到 landmark-or-transfer 门槛。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者报告 Stable Diffusion v1.5 的 FP32 latent round-trip MSE 在 10/20/50 steps 为 3.77e-9/1.98e-9/8.85e-10（Table 4, p. 63）；SD1.5 editing 中 Rex-Dopri5 的 LPIPS 为 0.107，DDIM/O-BELM 为 0.214/0.140（Table 7, p. 65）。这些均为作者报告。
analysis.caveatZh: algebraic reversibility 不等于所有 finite-precision setting 都稳定：Appendix H.8 报告 data-prediction latent variance 约 1e7，SDE data-prediction 甚至 overflow；图像实验也主要限于 SD1.5、CelebA-HQ 与 automatic metrics。
analysis.motivationZh: 普通 solver 正向采样后再反向积分会累积 discretization error，限制 real-image editing、accurate likelihood 与 differentiable reward；既有 exact-inversion schemes 又常受低阶、稳定域差或只支持 ODE 限制。
analysis.methodZh: Rex 先把 diffusion ODE/SDE 的 semi-linear structure 经 exponential Lawson change of variables 转成 Princeps scheme，再用 McCallum–Foster-style auxiliary state 与 coupling parameter 构造可闭式互逆的 forward/backward steps。ODE 版本继承 underlying RK order、支持 adaptive steps；SDE 版本用可重建 Brownian increments 保持 stochastic trajectory consistency。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者在 100 张 pix2pix real images 上测 finite-precision reconstruction，在 CelebA-HQ DDPM 上生成 10,000 samples，在 1,000 条 COCO captions 上测 SD1.5 conditional generation，并完成 InstructPix2Pix round-trip editing 与 tri-alanine Boltzmann sampling。Rex 在 inversion error 上明显领先，并在 editing preservation 与 preference metrics 上匹配或超过所测 reversible baselines；higher-order RK4 在 low-step image sampling 并不总优于 Euler。
analysis.insightZh: 最可迁移的观点不是“再造一个快 sampler”，而是把 solver 的可逆性当作 generation system 的一等接口：同一个 transformation 可覆盖 DDIM、DPM-Solver families、SEEDS-1 与 gDDIM，并把 sampling、editing、likelihood 和 gradient workflow 连接起来。
